# Positioning and offer: RepairLog

## Positioning statement
For independent bike shops with 1–3 mechanics who lose time on "is my bike ready?" calls, RepairLog is
a repair log that texts customers when their bike is ready. Unlike paper notebooks and phone photos
(F-2), every job, part and pickup lives in one place.

## Offer
59 PLN/month per shop (business case), first month paid up front, unlimited bikes, pickup SMS included.

## Objection map
| objection | honest answer | evidence level | basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| "My notebook works." | It does until a page is lost; RepairLog keeps the same job list and texts the customer. | stated intent | F-2, customer language |
